issues.description: Method Farm.singFarmSongVerse: In the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) the method is declared as private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/) (no formal parameter). The problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) specifies singFarmSongVerse(animal: Animal): void for Farm. The solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) implements private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal). This mismatch (template missing the Animal parameter) prevents students from implementing the per-animal verse printing as described and diverges from the provided solution, causing confusion about the expected signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method declaration to include the Animal parameter: private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) { ... } and update the method body to use the passed animal (e.g., animal.getClass().getSimpleName(), animal.messageOnFeed()) so it matches the problem statement UML and the solution implementation.

issues.description: Identifier/naming inconsistency: The example code in the template Main class (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java) calls farm.feed(); whereas the problem statement tasks and the solution use the API method feedAllAnimals() on Farm (described in problem_statement.md and present in solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java). This naming mismatch in the example may mislead students about which method they should implement or call.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the commented example in template Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(), aligning the example with the method name required by the problem statement and the solution. Alternatively, add a brief comment clarifying the correct method name to use.

issues.description: The concept is "feed all animals". The problem statement names the operation feedAllAnimals(). The template Main calls farm.feed(). The solution Main and solution Farm implement and call feedAllAnimals(). Because the template calls farm.feed() while the specification and solution use feedAllAnimals(), students may be unsure which method to implement or get compilation errors (template Farm does not define feed()).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent. Preferred: use feedAllAnimals() everywhere (as specified). Update the template Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() instead of farm.feed(), and/or add a short compatibility method in the template Farm.java: public void feed() { feedAllAnimals(); } Ensure the problem statement, template Farm API, and examples all reference feedAllAnimals().
